name: Archie self-improvement loop (fingerprint every hand fix by cause, file ONE ai-build issue per recurring cause, track it to merge, reopen or verify)

knobs.note: BH-4587: 0 stops the tick before any read. Read by bin/archie-fm-improve.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMI_ENABLED:-1}; any value other than 0 or 1 is one warn line in logs/archie-fm-improve.log and the default. The mode is the settings row archie.manage.hub > archie.manage (on|observe|off), shared with the other archie-fm lanes; the thresholds are the archie.improve.* settings rows and archie.cap.improve.

BH-4587: seconds after which a `started` improve row this lane left behind (a tick that died after its claim) is closed failed with ONE ALERTS line. It is never reclaimed; the work recurs under the next UTC day's key. Read by bin/archie-fm-improve.sh as ${ARCHIE_FMI_RETRY_S:-1800}; a value that is not a whole number is one warn line and the default.
Not a knob: bin/archie-fm-improve.sh sets it to 1 when it re-execs itself under its backstop timeout (900 s), so the child does not wrap itself again. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: epoch seconds bin/archie-fm-improve.sh uses as now, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam: a file bin/archie-fm-improve.sh sources after its libs, only when HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1. NOT settable from the control plane: it names a file a root lane sources.

Test seam gate: bin/archie-fm-improve.sh honours ARCHIE_FMI_NOW and sources ARCHIE_FMI_FIXTURE only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
